title: ⚡ Rapid Revision Master Sheet & High-Yield Top 10 (July 1–31, 2026)
summary: Consolidated last-mile revision sheet featuring the Top 10 highest-yield exam items, statutory status tracker, and cross-topic confusion matrix for July 2026...

blocks.content:
### 📌 Top 10 Highest-Yield Exam Items (July 2026 Rapid Revision Master List)

1. **EPFO Overhaul & EPF Scheme 2026:** Claim settlement compressed to **3 days** (pension/EDLI: 20 days); full withdrawal age lowered to **55 years**; auto-settlement cap raised to **₹5 Lakh**; principal employer liability introduced for contract workers.
2. **Small Savings & PF Interest Rates (Q2 FY27):** Sukanya Samriddhi (**8.20%**), EPF FY26 (**8.25%**), PPF (**7.10%**), GPF (**7.10%**).
3. **Tax Department SFT Reporting Thresholds:** Savings bank cash (≥**₹10 Lakh**), Current account cash (≥**₹50 Lakh**), Credit card cash (>**₹1 Lakh** / non-cash ≥**₹10 Lakh**), Real estate property (>**₹30 Lakh**).
4. **RBI Revamped Integrated Ombudsman Scheme:** Entity response timeline fixed at **30 days**; escalation to RBI Ombudsman within **90 days**; compensation cap of **₹30 Lakh** (loss) + **₹3 Lakh** (harassment).
5. **Headline Macro & Global Inflows:** Total Indian exports reached **$863.1 Billion in FY26**; India rose to **11th largest FDI recipient ($38.89 Billion)** under UNCTAD World Investment Report.
6. **Heritage & Global Laurels:** Sarnath inscribed as **India’s 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site** (48th Session, Busan); India ranks 6th globally and 2nd in Asia-Pacific.
7. **Historic Sports Records:** **Jannik Sinner** wins 2nd consecutive Wimbledon (5th Grand Slam); **Spain** defeats Argentina to become the first country in history to hold men’s and women’s FIFA World Cups simultaneously; **Vaibhav Sooryavanshi** becomes youngest Indian international debutant (15y 99d).
8. **Space & Aerospace Firsts:** **Skyroot’s Vikram-1** orbital launch (Mission ‘Aagaman’), making India the 3rd country with private orbital launch capability; Gaganyaan tests SOLVE, IMAT, and CMUS.
9. **Banking Minimum Balance Penalties:** Commercial banks collected **₹7,086 Crore in MAB penalties in FY26** (private banks formed 70% led by HDFC Bank at ₹1,798 Cr; 10 of 12 PSBs waived charges).
10. **Global Institution Appointments:** **Silvana Tenreyro** appointed Chief Economist of IMF; **Dilip Asbe** inducted into SWIFT’s global supervisory board; **Mahesh Muralidhar Pai** appointed MD & CEO of South Indian Bank.

### ⏰ Statutory & Regulatory Status Tracker (July 2026 Enactments)

| Bill / Regulatory Norm | Governing Body | Statutory Milestone | Key Regulatory Threshold |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Anti-Paper-Leak Bill (Public Examinations 2026)** | Parliament | ✅ **Enacted into Law** | Jail 5–10 years; Fine ₹50 Lakh; 8-yr debarment |
| **CBDT Cost Inflation Index (CII)** | CBDT / MoF | ✅ **Notified (FY 2026-27)** | **CII = 384** (effective 1 April 2026) |
| **RBI Integrated Ombudsman 2026** | RBI | ✅ **In Force (1 July 2026)** | ₹30L max compensation + ₹3L harassment |
| **SEBI FPI Fee Rationalisation** | SEBI | ✅ **Operational** | Cat-I fee: $1,000 ➔ **₹90,000** |
| **SEBI SWP/STP Demat Integration** | SEBI | ⏳ **Phased Implementation** | 31 Jan 2027 (Units) / 30 Apr 2027 (Amount) |
| **RBI Securitisation Demat Mandate** | RBI | ⏳ **Effective 1 Oct 2026** | Minimum ticket size: **₹1 Crore** |

🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Use this July master table for high-speed revision. Pay close attention to the 4-year FDI trajectory ($27.99bn ➔ $10.13bn ➔ $960mn ➔ $6.95bn) and the EPFO 3-day / 20-day / 55-year / ₹5 Lakh rules.
